@graph.name: SpectraFit-Core-Reproducibility: results and figures of the SoftwareX article on spectrafit-core 0.1.2
@graph.description: Everything the paper reports, regenerated from the public release of spectrafit-core 0.1.2: the compiled library from the PyPI wheel, the benchmark harness and the figure scripts from the repository at tag v0.1.2. The NIST comparison and all three figures are regenerated on every run. The wall-clock benchmark was measured on terra with the same wheel and harness (results/timing/, 160 cases) and is verified by SHA-256 on every run. Each number in the prose is recomputed from these files in results/claims-report.json.
